name: Auto Image Title & Alt
author: Diego de Guindos

sections.description:
This plugin automatically improves your SEO by adding the Title and Alt Text tags to any new image uploaded to your media library. It uses the file name as the base for these tags, cleaning it from non-alphanumeric characters.

This is a repetitive manual task that can now be 100% automated with this plugin.

New features and improvements:
– Select which image fields to update: Title, Alt Text, Caption (Excerpt), and Description (Content).
– Choose capitalization format for titles: Capitalized (default), lowercase, UPPERCASE, or leave as-is.
– The plugin respects your selected options and only modifies fields you want.
– Lightweight and does not affect site performance.
– Easy to use with a simple settings page in WordPress admin.
– Improves website accessibility and Google image context.
– Fully compatible with the latest WordPress versions.

Plugin features:
– Automatically set image title based on the cleaned file name.
– Automatically set image Alt Text based on the cleaned file name.
– Optionally update caption and description fields.
– Configurable capitalization styles.
– Saves time by automating tedious manual edits.
– No impact on site speed or performance.
